summary: Complete inline Requirements reading verified for accepted and staged content, with all saved fields, safe rich rendering, keyboard scrolling, diagrams, source fidelity and protected live authoring.

checks.title: Complete format-aware inline presentation
checks.detail: Markdown, sanitized HTML and literal plain text render through the shared reader. Tables, code, multiple positioned Mermaid/DOT diagrams, diagram-only items, source access and safe failures pass desktop and compact browser checks.

checks.title: Full selected-context discovery and summary relationships
checks.detail: Main items show complete content, format, kind, tags, dependencies, Sources, reverse summaries and diagram mappings. Existing kind/tag/search filters and context navigation pass rich-content and proposal-authoring regressions. Independent MCP reads confirm accepted/staged isolation.

checks.title: Executed full reading and direct Changes editing verification
checks.detail: 151 automated tests and 37 distinct browser tests pass across full-content, reading-editing, rich-content, proposal-authoring and lifecycle suites. Built Worker full-content and reading-editing checks pass with independently authenticated MCP access through a second local process. TypeScript and production build pass.

checks.title: All saved content readable inline by normal page scrolling
checks.detail: Verified full plain-text titles and ordered criteria, all parameter values, links, tags and summary relationships; an exact 50,000-code-point body; authored ellipses and Unicode; complete inline diagrams; vertically expanding items; and keyboard scrolling of wide tables/code. Live staged changes refresh body and metadata together while preserving dirty editor input. Read-only rendering leaves accepted source, snapshots, lifecycle and evidence unchanged.

earlier_results: The first full-content run exposed squeezed table columns. The table layout was corrected and all full-content checks subsequently passed in both development and built Worker runs.

The first combined built-Worker run passed all five full-content tests. The reading-editing fixture setup failed with a Miniflare D1 internal error while writing large snapshots during concurrent test execution. Repeating reading-editing alone passed all eleven tests; the original failure log is retained.

The first automated run included temporary unrelated shared-checkout edits and passed 153 tests. After those edits disappeared, the final current-tree run passed 151 tests; only that final count is claimed.

limits: Verification used local isolated QA projects and emulated loopback sign-in; hosted OAuth and deployment were not tested.
Implementation and this report are local repository artifacts. No publication or remote Git reachability is claimed.
The evidence URL points to the existing loopback development server and is available only where that server is running.
